title: Gateway update observations follow their real sources
description: Use private Git repositories and a fixture actor to observe source failures, repair, atomic operation files, installed HEAD, and offline SQLite restoration with source age. Recover the same cold browser runtime. No provider, native or checkout-update command execution.

proofTargets.claim: A real Git source failure retains last successful source time and remote facts.
An explicit source repair/recheck updates the same mounted runtime.
An independent atomic checkout-operation record appears in the mounted panel.
A real private Git checkout updates installed state without Refresh.
Local operation and Git changes cause zero additional remote checks.
Actual SQLite retains source facts and excludes live diagnostics.
A new offline browser runtime restores the exact scoped SQLite source facts.
Cold facts retain their original source success time and show saved age.
The same cold browser runtime recovers after the owned gateway restarts.
Two mounted browser viewers share one upstream sample and one persistent owner.
A settled mounted gateway-status panel emits zero reads over its former 30-second polling interval.
